scope: Independent correctness review of frozen original-question-only source_question_family reconstruction of Farb Question 7.6; no candidate comparison or priority clearance.
strongest_verified_claim: For every fixed closed oriented genus g>=2 and finite k>=3, and every N>=1, there are N pseudo-Anosovs in I_g(k) with one common exact dilatation and pairwise distinct orientation-preserving Mod_g conjugacy classes.
critical_mechanism: A rank-two Schottky subgroup in the fixed filtration term has compact convex core. For a compact K with JK=X, finite S={s in G:sK intersects K} uniformly bounds subgroup conjugacy classes inside any ambient derivative conjugacy class. Unique invariant disks bring every ambient mapping-class conjugator into the full stabilizer.
counterexample_test: Dropping convex cocompactness fails: ker(F(a,b)->Z, a->0,b->1) contains infinitely many subgroup-conjugacy classes b^n a b^-n in one ambient class. The frozen proof has the needed compactness hypothesis.
verified_interfaces: separating filling curves in genus 2 and above
full-matrix commutator identity and its recurrence
parabolic conjugation, disjoint endpoints and convex-cocompact high powers
existence of compact K and finiteness of S for any discrete overgroup
one reference axis point fixed for all conjugators of each u
uniformity independent of lengths, proper powers and finite generation of G
full ambient Mod_g conjugacy and finite derivative kernel
Horowitz universal trace scope, SL lifts and length normalization

computational_evidence.limitation: Finite consistency controls do not certify infinite claims; the symbolic/geometric derivations and checked standard theorems do that work.

limitations: No ambient primitivity or simple-loop assertion
No infinite multiplicity at one fixed length
No assertion for the intersection of all Johnson terms
